exposure: Ultrasound-guided transverse abdominal plane block (TAPB) combined with general anesthesia (GA)
outcome: Effective press of the analgesic pump
cohort: A total of 90 patients scheduled for radical resection of endometrial carcinoma were randomized to receive either ultrasound-guided TAPB combined with general anesthesia or general anesthesia alone.
finding: Ultrasound-guided TAPB combined with general anesthesia significantly reduced postoperative levels of neutrophil, NLR, and SII, improved postoperative pain intensity, decreased opioid consumption, and lowered the incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting compared to general anesthesia alone.
